critical_alerts: ANA titer 1:320 is abnormal and above the reference range of <1:40
ai_overview.overview: The patient is a 48-year-old female with a history of lupus, currently managed with Prednisone 10mg daily and Hydroxychloroquine 200mg twice daily. During the most recent follow-up on July 9, 2026, the patient's vitals were blood pressure 123/69, heart rate 84 bpm, temperature 37.10°C, oxygen saturation 98.30%, and BMI 27.13. The patient reported a pain level of 1. A previous ANA titer test from February 2026 showed an abnormal result of 1:320, which is above the reference range of <1:40.
